title: Titus Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Titus 2: what fits sound doctrine for older men, older women, young wives, younger men and servants, and the grace of God that has appeared.

questions.text: What should older men be, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, and sound in faith, in love and in perseverance.

questions.text: What should older women not be enslaved to?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says older women should be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, and not enslaved to much wine.

questions.text: What are the older women to train the young wives to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they may train the young wives to love their husbands and to love their children.

answers.text: To love their husbands and children
To teach in the house of the elders
To give their money to the saints
To keep the fables of the fathers

questions.text: Why are the young wives to live as verse 5 describes?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they are to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind and in subjection to their own husbands, so that God's word may not be blasphemed.

answers.text: So that their children may believe
So that the older women may rest
So that God's word may not be blasphemed
So that their husbands may be rich

questions.text: Whom does verse 6 say to exhort to be sober minded?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says to exhort the younger men likewise to be sober minded.

questions.text: What is the one addressed told to show himself to be in all things?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that in all things he should be showing himself an example of good works, and that in his teaching he should show integrity, seriousness and incorruptibility.

questions.text: What are servants told not to do, in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they should not steal, but show all good fidelity, so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.

questions.text: What has appeared, bringing salvation to all men?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says that the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men.

questions.text: What are we described as looking for in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says we are looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.

answers.text: The reward promised for our own good works
The rest promised to the faithful servants
The blessed hope and the appearing of his glory
The lasting peace of this present age

questions.text: What kind of people did he purify for his own possession, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he gave himself to redeem us from all iniquity and to purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

answers.text: A people zealous for good works
A people gathered out of one city
A people taught by their elders
A people rich in this present age
